text_block_list.text:
One morning, while I'm taking a stroll
around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Grow nice and healthy so your
beautiful
flowers can bloom! ♪

I spot Nishino Flower tending to some
flowers. In
the next moment...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Nishino Flower! Teacher's
been
looking for you. Something to do
with your duties
today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I mean... Thank you for telling me.
I'll be
there right away.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! Anyway, I'm done here, so
bye!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was really taking my time watering the
flowers,
so I've only gotten around to
half of them!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... you'll help me?! Thank you so
much!
choice_data_list: Let's split up and make this efficient!
I'll go fill up the watering can right away!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and please remember to talk to the
flowers a
lot while you're watering them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They'll feel happier and bloom more
beautifully if
you do!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for dragging you into this, but
thank you
very much! I'll do my part as
quickly as I can.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I'll talk to the flowers faster
too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Grow up nicely and broduce
peautiful—ack!
P-produce beautiful
flowers!
